sentences.text: Shri Manikant Sharma, learned counsel for the petitioner.
Shri Tapan Bathre, learned panel lawyer for the respondents/State.

Challenge is being made to the order dated 17.12.2019 passed by the learned Trial Court whereby the application filed by the petitioner in pursuance to the amendment incorporated in Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 under Section 16 and 16-A has been incorporated for disposing of the matter by imposing a fine of Rs.2,00,000/- has been rejected.
The application was rejected in the year 2019 and thereafter no such order sheets have been filed to demonstrate the current status of the case.
In such circumstances, the petitioner is directed to file the latest order sheets of the case to demonstrate the current status of the case.
He prays for and is granted seven days to do the needful.
List the case in the next week.

(VISH  
 AM Signature  SAN Not Verified M/S Nirma Ltd .
